overlap.scope: All-state inequality for consecutive contiguous even four-site projectors. Cyclic copies are defined by conjugation with the fermionic mode-translation unitary.

certificates.scope: Exact lower bound for the half-filled uniform Hubbard chain at U=4,t=1. Local positivity holds on the full Fock space; the centered bulk shift vanishes at half filling. This is an extendibility constraint, not a general representability oracle.
